bounds.domain: One environment-restoration call with two LLM settings, a live or deterministic provider, and absent/known-mock/live endpoint classes.
bounds.assumptions: Endpoint classification abstracts the URL parser and the supplied registered mock settings. Refusal preserves the function-entry environment; earlier factory environment writes are outside this atomic call.
bounds.progress: Safety only. This synchronous operation has no provider or scheduler liveness assumption.
limitations: This is not a model of complete runtime construction, concurrent runtimes, provider correctness, credential validity, or physical network isolation. The source-linked test runs the actual restoration function and actual Twilio Request redirection over loopback HTTP. Full deterministic/live scenario runs remain separate acceptance evidence.
